scope.raw_replay_population: all 168 frozen records, horizontal G2 only

issues.finding: ExSpike APEC is direct prior art, and every frozen M501 record has only zero plus one positive amplitude. The measured exact-value overlap is support intersection and exposes no H67-native signed/multi-amplitude novelty.

The 16.03125-KiB value is capacity arithmetic only. Group buffering/comparison, macro organization/ports/latency, weight readiness, two-destination overlap fanout, commit pressure, borders, and interaction with the selected parent/PWP path are absent.
The validation cohort contains ten windows from one Zurich sequence. The 18-sequence distribution is train-only calibration and cannot establish heldout robustness.
The result SHA256SUMS omits the runner. The separately sealed runtime hammer pins runner SHA 51b1011a..., so the composite chain is usable but the result directory is not self-contained.

one_time_same_resource_cycle_fastkill.purpose: Decide whether APEC can survive real scheduling and storage costs as a non-novel supporting mechanism; it cannot admit a standalone RTL contribution.
one_time_same_resource_cycle_fastkill.frozen_point: H67 ep35 validation S10, four bottleneck Conv inputs, horizontal G2
one_time_same_resource_cycle_fastkill.baseline: The exact same selected Conv engine and task order with APEC disabled. If layered on M473/M504, both arms must use the identical admitted storage/port organization; no ideal M473 arm may be compared against a charged candidate or vice versa.
resource_equality: same lane count, frequency target, eight weight banks, 128 B/cycle external weight bandwidth, output-bank count, row tile and CAM budget
same total on-chip SRAM capacity and macro port budget; the 16.03125-KiB overlap scratch must displace equal capacity or be included in an area-normalized comparison
same always-ready or backpressured psum-sink assumption in both arms, stated explicitly
minimum_cost_model: runtime horizontal-G2 pair formation, exact-value comparator and group input buffering
overlap plus both residual descriptor issues using the real bank mapping and weight-read transactions
generated or explicitly bounded synchronous overlap-scratch read/write ports and latency, with 16/19/24/32-bit sensitivity
one overlap result delivered to two shifted destinations, including destination-bank conflicts, commit/update cycles and border/tail behavior
queue occupancy, backpressure, scratch-port conflicts, weight-not-ready stalls and zero-descriptor fetch suppression
interaction with the selected parent/PWP reuse path without multiplying independent speedups

decision_after_run.any_gate_fails: KILL_M501_HARDWARE_LINE; retain the opportunity result only as a DSE/prior-art comparison.
decision_after_run.all_gates_pass: May be retained only as a cited ExSpike-derived supporting mechanism inside a separately novel H67 architecture, after macro-aware cost and another independent review. Still no standalone APEC RTL novelty.
